comment: she is decent at explaining things through but the amount of homework is insane. She always gives out writing prompts, makes us do online hw, gives 6 pages of paper hw every week and projects . Its just way to much. I feel very overwhelmed and feel the amount of work I do outside of this class is insane. Expect HOURS of homework every single day.
Would not recommend... all material is "taught" in lecture by example problems. Little opportunity to boost your grade after a bad score, no partial or leverage is granted in grading.

Burmeister was great! It was the epitome of a college class, you go sit down and she just goes through the chapter sections in a very clear and organized way. It could be boring sometimes, but it was never hard. To do well on exams you need to actually know the material, but she basically tells you exactly what will be on it. Very nice woman!

I am not the best at math, but I found Burmeister's course to be manageable. There are 3 tests (+1 final) and 3 quizzes. She always tells you what is going to be on the tests. She often lets you do partner quizzes/bring a notecard with formulas. She also often lets class out early. Her class is by no means easy, but she is a good professor.

Need to actually buy the textbook because all the hw is online. Her quizzes and tests are also rlly great cause she tells you exactly what's gonna be on there and doesn't add any extra hard "thinker" questions to trip you up. She even does that for the final

probably the easiest math professor I've ever had. you never have to participate, very clear abt grading, class always gets out early, really easy to pick up what she's teaching, it was great. I got a 2 on AP calc senior year and then took this class and got an A, I feel like that says a lot about her teaching ability.
